inference: A serialized source-profile comparison is possible across the named WB roots and their direct child references, with distinct owner identities retained. The evidence does not establish runtime use, field operation, or player-facing counts or durations.
unresolved: NumberOfMagazines is reported as a serialized value only; its carried-use meaning is unresolved.
The deploy child tuple member roles and units are unresolved.
Runtime selection, activation, composition, and operation are not established by the direct serialized WB-to-child references.
Same-hash fields under other owner classes have no demonstrated selector or join to the base Ammo/Reload profile.
siteImpact: The serialized WB profiles can be compared as source data: each has MagazineCapacity 1, NumberOfMagazines 1, and ReloadTime 0.0; each directly imports a one-element child array with two float members (Adrenaline Shot 0.0/0.0; PTKM1R 0.22499999403953552/0.3499999940395355). The child member roles and units are unknown. No gadget table exists in the site, and these facts do not support a carried-use count, swap-time display, or gameplay comparison. No site proposal.

leads.title: Adrenaline Shot and PTKM1R handling/ammunition
leads.summary: Both hotfix WBs directly reference their deploy-time children and store mapped MagazineCapacity 1, NumberOfMagazines 1, and ReloadTime 0. The child tuples differ but have no mapped roles or units, so no available-use or swap-time comparison is supported.
leads.reopenWhen: Reopen only if authoritative member-role/unit mapping or a consumer/selection route establishes the meaning needed for a site comparison.
